title: QA Pilot ↔ Librarian MCP Custody Packet
description: Schema for a custody packet that defines whether and how The Librarian may broker calls to QA Pilot's own MCP surface. This is a decision/constraint document — it does not authorize implementation.

authorized_next_path.description: What future path is authorized by this decision.
